title: Ten Winters and One Short Tube
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（人与社会·科学与技术）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（人与社会·科学与技术）　|　核心词汇：experiment　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 experiment 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 my father ① ran an experiment that no student in the lab would have repeated, and he said the running was the whole of the winter. The ② experiment, meaning the trial itself and not the theory, ran ten winters and stayed unrepeated in the book; an experiment, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unrepeated.

Every ③ experiment in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ experiment at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the paper and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An experiment, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to repeat; my father said the repeating is the part that fills ten winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the experiment was the whole of the method, meaning the test and not the trial. The ⑥ experiment, meaning the test and not any of that, is the only thing in a method that everybody waits for and nobody repeats; experiment, he said, is either something you run or the only word that means both a trial and a test. He said the test is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ experiment had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ experiment of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one lab and ten winters of repeating; experiment, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to repeat. He said the repeating was never mentioned.

The ⑨ experiment I remember is the one repeated in the notebook, which closed in 1984 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. An ⑩ experiment, my mother said in 1986, is the only one that improves by being repeated; every experiment, she said, is a test that has agreed to look like a trial. She said the test was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 实验（指实验室里每一项旁边的那一项）
B. n. 实验（指那一项本身，与理论相对）
C. 固定搭配：run an experiment 做一项实验
D. n. 实验（指留给论文的那一项）
E. n. 实验（抽象总称，指一间实验室的试验之事）
F. n. 实验（指记录本上写到、被复做的那一项）
G. n. 试验；尝试（指一种方法里人人都等却无人复做的那样东西）
H. n. 尝试（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人复做的那样东西）

items.q: ran an experiment that no student in the lab would have repeated

the experiment at the far side

answers.why: run an experiment 意为“做一项实验”，1973 年父亲做了一项实验室里没有一位学生肯复做的实验。
experiment 意为“实验”，指那一项本身而不是理论，它经过了十个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
experiment 意为“实验”，指实验室里每一项旁边的那一项，每一项旁边都有同一支短短的试管。
experiment 意为“实验”，指留给论文的那一项，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
experiment 意为“试验、尝试”，指一种方法里人人都等却无人复做的那样东西，叔叔说这次试验就是那种方法的全部。
experiment 意为“尝试”，指人人都等却无人复做的那样东西而不是那一项实验，是方法里人人都等、却无人复做的东西。
experiment 意为“实验”，指记录本上写到、被复做的那一项，到 1981 年这一项成了记录本里的一行。
experiment 意为“实验”，父亲一月写道，整件事的试验之事是一间实验室和十个冬天的复做。
experiment 意为“实验”，我记得的是记录本上复做的那一项，1984 年结束了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一项。
experiment 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，一项实验是唯一会因为被好好复做而变得更好的东西。
